us: {name:A283E1}{line}The Craftsmoogles' League have been called in to{line}service all ten of the windmills on the Steppe,{line}kupo. This is the {color:8095}No. 1{color:8080} mill.
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Das Mogry-Bauunternehmen kümmert sich um die{line}Wartung der Mühlen, kupo. Es gibt derer zehn in{line}der Cerobi-Steppe. Dieses ist {color:8095}Windmühle 1{color:8080}, kupo.
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Nos han encargado a los Mogulaboriosos el{line}mantenimiento de los molinos, kupó. En Cerobi{line}hay diez molinos, y este es el {color:8095}n.° 1{color:809B}, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}On a fait appel à la Compagnie des Mogs pour{line}réviser les dix moulins à vent de Cérobi, kupo.{line}Ceci est le {color:8095}moulin n°1{color:8080}.
it: {name:A283E1}{line}L'Edilmogu deve riparare i mulini, kupò.{line}Qui sull'Altopiano di Cerobi ce ne sono dieci.{line}Questo è il numero {color:8095}1{color:8080}.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}モーグリ工務店は風車の整備を引き受けたクポ。{line}ちなみにセロビ台地の風車は全10基クポ。{line}この風車は{color:8095}第１号基{color:8080}クポ。

cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}莫古利工务店承接风车的维修工作咕波。{line}附带一提，榭洛比台地的风车共有10座咕波。{line}这座风车是{color:8095}第１号机{color:8080}咕波。

cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}又见到你了咕波！这次是进行风车的维修咕波～{line}莫古负责的是这座{color:8095}第２号机{color:8080}咕波。{line}我们这些伙伴们分头进行10座风车的维修咕波。

in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}今は回っているけれど、モグが整備した{color:8095}第３号基{color:8080}は{line}操作すればピタッと止まるクポ。{line}{choice:2}[停止させる|何もしない]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}How have you been, kupo? We're servicing the{line}windmills of Cerobi Steppe. This is {color:8095}No. 4{color:8080} of{line}ten of the finest 'mills you ever did see, kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Oh, so trifft man sich wieder, kupo! Meine Kollegen{line}und ich warten jetzt die zehn Windmühlen in der{line}Cerobi-Steppe. Dies ist {color:8095}Windmühle 4{color:8080}, kupo.
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Dichosos los ojos! Estamos poniendo a punto{line}los molinos, kupó. Este es el {color:8095}n.° 4{color:809B}, kupó.{line}En Cerobi hay diez en total, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Comment ça va, kupo ? Nous révisons les moulins{line}à vent des plateaux de Cérobi. Celui-ci est le{line}{color:8095}moulin n°4{color:8080}. Il est beau, hein, kupo ?
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Quanto tempo! Stiamo riparando i mulini, kupò.{line}Questo è il numero {color:8095}4{color:8080}. Sull'Altopiano di Cerobi{line}ce ne sono dieci.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}久しぶりクポ。モグたち、今は風車を整備してるクポ。{line}この風車は{color:8095}第４号基{color:8080}クポ。{line}セロビ台地の風車は全部で10基あるクポ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}오랜만 쿠뽀. 모그들, 지금은 풍차 정비 중 쿠뽀.{line}이 풍차는 {color:8095}제4호기{color:8080} 쿠뽀.{line}세로비 대지의 풍차는 총 10기다 쿠뽀.
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}好久不见咕波。莫古们正在维修风车咕波。{line}这座风车是{color:8095}第４号机{color:8080}咕波。{line}榭洛比台地的风车共有10座咕波。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}好久不見咕波。莫古們正在維修風車咕波。{line}這座風車是{color:8095}第４號機{color:8080}咕波。{line}榭洛比台地的風車共有10座咕波。

us: {name:A283E1}{line}The {color:8095}No. 4{color:8080} windmill's in perfect order. I can stop{line}it whenever I like. Would you like to see, kupo?{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]
de: {name:A283E1}{line}{color:8095}Windmühle 4{color:8080} lässt sich jetzt jederzeit problemlos{line}anhalten. Soll ich 's mal demonstrieren, kupo?{line}{choice:2}[Anhalten|Drehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}El molino {color:8095}n.° 4{color:809B} está en perfectas condiciones, kupó.{line}¿Quieres que lo pare para probarlo, kupó?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Le {color:8095}moulin n°4{color:8080} est fin prêt. Je peux l'arrêter,{line}vous savez. Vous voulez voir, kupo ?{line}{choice:2}[L'arrêter.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Se funziona bene, un mulino si può far fermare a{line}piacimento, kupò. Vediamo se il mulino {color:8095}4{color:8080} è a posto?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}しっかり整備した風車は止めたいときに止められるクポ。{line}{color:8095}第４号基{color:8080}の整備具合を確かめるクポ？{line}{choice:2}[停止させる|何もしない]
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}확실히 정비한 풍차는 멈추고 싶을 때 멈출 수 있다 쿠뽀.{line}{color:8095}제4호기{color:8080}의 정비상태를 확인할 거 쿠뽀?{line}{choice:2}[정지시킨다|아무것도 안 한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}仔细维修好的风车在想要停止的时候就能停止咕波。{line}要确认{color:8095}第４号机{color:8080}的维修状况吗咕波？{line}{choice:2}[停止|什么都不做]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Please, please! I've work to do, kupo. We have to{line}get all ten windmills in good order. I'm in charge{line}of {color:8095}No. 5{color:8080} here.
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Hey, hey, bin grade sehr beschäftigt, kupo. Bevor{line}die zehn Windmühlen hier nicht wieder laufen, gibt{line}es keinen Feierabend. Ich arbeite an {color:8095}Windmühle 5{color:8080}.
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Por favor, déjame trabajar, kupó! Tenemos que{line}poner a punto los diez molinos que hay aquí, kupó.{line}A mí me ha tocado el {color:8095}n.° 5{color:809B}, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Vite, vite ! J'ai du travail. Nous devons réviser{line}les dix moulins à vent. Moi, on m'a confié le{line}{color:8095}moulin n°5{color:8080}.
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Ho tantissimo lavoro da fare, kupò.{line}Ci sono dieci mulini da aggiustare.{line}Questo è quello di cui mi occupo io, il numero {color:8095}5{color:8080}.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}ちょっとちょっと、仕事の邪魔は困るクポ。{line}10基の風車を全部整備しないと仕事が終わらないクポ。{line}モグが任された{color:8095}第５号基{color:8080}は、まだ整備中クポ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}저기저기, 업무방해는 곤란 쿠뽀.{line}10기의 풍차를 전부 정비하지 않으면 일이 끝나지 않는다 쿠뽀.{line}모그가 맡은 {color:8095}제5호기{color:8080}는 아직 정비 중 쿠뽀.
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}喂喂，这样妨碍工作很令人伤脑筋咕波。{line}不把10座风车全部维修完，工作就没办法结束咕波。{line}莫古被委任的是{color:8095}第５号机{color:8080}，还在进行维修咕波。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}喂喂，這樣妨礙工作很令人傷腦筋咕波。{line}不把10座風車全部維修完，工作就沒辦法結束咕波。{line}莫古被委任的是{color:8095}第５號機{color:8080}，還在進行維修咕波。

us: {name:A283E1}{line}The {color:8095}No. 5{color:8080} mill is running smooth as can be, kupo.{line}Want to see me stop it? I'll stop it, kupo.{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]

es: {name:A283E1}{line}El molino {color:8095}n.° 5{color:809B} funciona perfectamente, kupó.{line}¿Quieres ver cómo se detiene, kupó?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Le {color:8095}moulin n°5{color:8080} marche à merveille.{line}Si vous voulez, je l'arrête, kupo !{line}{choice:2}[L'arrêter.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Questo che dovevo aggiustare io è il mulino {color:8095}5{color:8080}.{line}Ora funziona bene, kupò. Proviamo a fermarlo?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}モグが任された{color:8095}第５号基{color:8080}の調子は上々クポ。{line}風車が止まるところを見たいクポ？{line}{choice:2}[停止させる|何もしない]
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}모그가 맡은 {color:8095}제5호기{color:8080}의 상태는 아주 좋다 쿠뽀.{line}풍차가 멈추는 걸 보고 싶냐 쿠뽀?{line}{choice:2}[정지시킨다|아무것도 안 한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}莫古被委任的{color:8095}第５号机{color:8080}情况十分顺利咕波。{line}想看风车停下来的样子吗咕波？{line}{choice:2}[停止|什么都不做]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}I thought you'd never ask, kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Ha, wusste ich 's doch, kupo!

fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Je savais que vous alliez me le demander, kupo !
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}そう言うと思ったクポ！
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}就知道你会这么说咕波！
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}就知道你會這麼說咕波！

us: {name:A283E1}{line}There you go. All stopped, kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Ich bin genial! Sie steht, kupo!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Ya está. No se mueve más, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Et voilà. Je l'ai arrêté, kupo !
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}よしよし、止まったクポ！
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}好了好了，停下来了咕波！
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}好了好了，停下來了咕波！

us: {name:A283E1}{line}I really wanted to show you how well it's{line}working, kupo...
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Och menno! Wollt 's so gern zeigen, kupo!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Hubiera querido mostrártelo, kupó...
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Oh, et moi qui avais tellement envie de vous{line}montrer comme il s'arrête bien, kupo...
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}見てほしかったクポ……。
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}本来希望你能看看的咕波……
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}本來希望你能看看的咕波……

us: {name:A283E1}{line}The {color:8095}No. 5{color:8080} mill is running smooth as can be, kupo.{line}Want to see me start it? I'll start it, kupo.{line}{choice:2}[Start the windmill.|Do nothing.]
de: {name:A283E1}{line}{color:8095}Windmühle 5{color:8080} ist top in Schuss, kupo.{line}Soll ich die Mühle mal anschmeißen, kupo?{line}{choice:2}[In Gang setzen|Still stehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}El molino {color:8095}n.° 5{color:809B} funciona perfectamente, kupó.{line}¿Quieres verlo moverse, kupó?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Le {color:8095}moulin n°5{color:8080} marche à merveille.{line}Si vous voulez, je le mets en route, kupo !{line}{choice:2}[Le mettre en route.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Questo che dovevo aggiustare io è il mulino {color:8095}5{color:8080}.{line}Ora funziona bene, kupò. Proviamo a farlo partire?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}I really wanted to show you how well it's{line}working, kupo...

ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}本來希望你能看看的咕波……

us: {name:A283E1}{line}We're racing to see who can finish work on{line}their windmill first, kupo. I'm going to have{line}{color:8095}No. 6{color:8080} up and running before the rest!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Wir vom Mogry-Bauunternehmen wetteifern, wer{line}seine Mühle als Erster in Schuss hat, kupo. Ich{line}arbeite an {color:8095}Windmühle 6{color:8080}. Insgesamt gibt 's zehn!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Estamos compitiendo a ver quién termina primero{line}con su molino, kupó. El mío es el {color:8095}n.° 6{color:809B}, kupó.{line}¡Estará listo antes que los otros nueve, kupó!
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Nous faisons la course pour voir qui va finir la{line}révision de son moulin en premier, kupo. Il faut{line}que je répare le {color:8095}moulin n°6{color:8080} avant les autres !
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Stiamo facendo una gara a chi finisce prima i lavori.{line}Io devo aggiustare il mulino {color:8095}6{color:8080}, kupò.{line}Deve funzionare prima di tutti gli altri nove!
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}誰が先に風車の整備を終えるか競争してるクポ！{line}モグが{color:8095}第６号基{color:8080}の整備担当クポ。{line}他の９基の風車より早く仕上げるのが目標クポ！
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}누가 먼저 풍차 정비를 마치는지 경쟁 중 쿠뽀!{line}모그가 {color:8095}제6호기{color:8080}의 정비담당 쿠뽀.{line}다른 9기의 풍차보다 빨리 마치는 게 목표 쿠뽀!
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}我们在比赛看谁先把风车维修好咕波！{line}莫古负责{color:8095}第６号机{color:8080}的维修工作咕波。{line}目标是要比其他９座风车都还要更快维修好咕波！
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}我們在比賽看誰先把風車維修好咕波！{line}莫古負責{color:8095}第６號機{color:8080}的維修工作咕波。{line}目標是要比其他９座風車都還要更快維修好咕波！

us: {name:A283E1}{line}I can stop the {color:8095}No. 6{color:8080} mill if you want, kupo.{line}Stop, start. Start, stop. Kupo, kupo!{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Soll ich mal zeigen, wie butterweich {color:8095}Windmühle 6{color:8080}{line}anhält? Steckt filigranste Mechanik dahinter!{line}{choice:2}[Anhalten|Drehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¿Quieres que detenga el molino {color:8095}n.° 6{color:809B}, kupó?{line}¡Es muy fácil, kupó!{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Je peux arrêter le {color:8095}moulin n°6{color:8080} si ça vous dit.{line}Eteint, allumé. Allumé, éteint. Kupo, kupo !{line}{choice:2}[L'arrêter.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Questo è il mulino {color:8095}6{color:8080}. Volete provare a fermarlo?{line}Si può sia far partire che far fermare.{line}{choice:2}[Proviamo a fermarlo.|Lasciamo stare.]
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}この{color:8095}第６号基{color:8080}を止めてみるクポ？{line}風車は動かすだけじゃなく、止めるのも自由自在クポ！{line}{choice:2}[停止させる|何もしない]
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}이 {color:8095}제6호기{color:8080}를 멈춰볼 거 쿠뽀?{line}풍차는 움직이는 것뿐 아니라 멈추는 것도 자유자재 쿠뽀!{line}{choice:2}[정지시킨다|아무것도 안 한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}要停止这座{color:8095}第６号机{color:8080}看看吗咕波？{line}不只能让风车动，也可随意让它停下来咕波！{line}{choice:2}[停止|什么都不做]
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}要停止這座{color:8095}第６號機{color:8080}看看嗎咕波？{line}不只能讓風車動，也可隨意讓它停下來咕波！{line}{choice:2}[停止|什麼都不做]

es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡A la orden, kupó!
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Hop hop hop, kupo !

ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}沒問題咕波～！

es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Se ha detenido, kupó!
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Moulin arrêté, kupo !
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}ストップしたクポ～！

ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}……覺得無所謂嗎咕波？

us: {name:A283E1}{line}I can start the {color:8095}No. 6{color:8080} mill if you want, kupo.{line}A windmill isn't a windmill unless it's milling!{line}{choice:2}[Start the windmill.|Do nothing.]

es: {name:A283E1}{line}¿Pongo en marcha el molino {color:8095}n.° 6{color:809B}, kupó?{line}¡Es muy fácil, kupó!{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Je peux mettre le {color:8095}moulin n°6{color:8080} en route si ça vous{line}dit. Eteint, allumé. Allumé, éteint. Kupo, kupo !{line}{choice:2}[Le mettre en route.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Volete provare a far funzionare il mulino {color:8095}6{color:8080}?{line}Se non gira, che mulino è?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]

kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}이 {color:8095}제6호기{color:8080}를 움직일 거 쿠뽀?{line}풍차는 빙글빙글 돌려야 풍차 쿠뽀!{line}{choice:2}[움직인다|아무것도 안 한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}要让这座{color:8095}第６号机{color:8080}转动吗咕波？{line}风车就是要转动才是风车啊咕波！{line}{choice:2}[转动|什么都不做]
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}要讓這座{color:8095}第６號機{color:8080}轉動嗎咕波？{line}風車就是要轉動才是風車啊咕波！{line}{choice:2}[轉動|什麼都不做]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}The salt in the air has made a mess of these{line}mills. We've got to service all ten on the Steppe.{line}I'm working on {color:8095}No. 7{color:8080}, kupo.
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Salzige Winde haben die zehn Windmühlen hier ros-{line}ten lassen, kupo. Aber kein Problem für das Mogry-{line}Bauunternehmen. Ich repariere {color:8095}Windmühle 7{color:8080}, kupo.
es: {name:A283E1}{line}El viento del mar perjudica a los molinos,{line}kupó. En Cerobi hay diez de ellos, y a mí me{line}toca mantener el {color:8095}n.° 7{color:809B}, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Le sel qu'il y a dans l'air a abîmé les rouages des{line}moulins de Cérobi. Nous les révisons tous les dix.{line}Moi, je m'occupe du {color:8095}moulin n°7{color:8080}, kupo.
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Questo mulino è il numero {color:8095}7{color:8080}, kupò.{line}Era tutto rovinato e così lo sto riparando.{line}Nell'Altopiano di Cerobi ce ne sono dieci!
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}潮風で調子が悪くなった風車の整備中クポ。{line}セロビ台地には全部で10基の風車があるクポ。{line}モグが面倒を見ているのは{color:8095}第７号基{color:8080}クポ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}바닷바람에 상태가 나빠진 풍차를 정비 중 쿠뽀.{line}세로비 대지에는 총 10기의 풍차가 있다 쿠뽀.{line}모그가 돌보고 있는 건 {color:8095}제7호기{color:8080} 쿠뽀.
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}我正在维修因海风而有点坏掉的风车咕波。{line}榭洛比台地共有10座风车咕波。{line}莫古负责的是{color:8095}第７号机{color:8080}咕波。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}我正在維修因海風而有點壞掉的風車咕波。{line}榭洛比台地共有10座風車咕波。{line}莫古負責的是{color:8095}第７號機{color:8080}咕波。

us: {name:A283E1}{line}I've replaced the parts, so the brakes on{line}{color:8095}No. 7{color:8080} are better than ever. Need it stopped?{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Dank brandneuer Komponenten ist {color:8095}Windmühle 7{color:8080}{line}kupo bedienungsfreundlich. 'ne Demonstration?{line}{choice:2}[Anhalten|Drehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}He cambiado algunas piezas; el freno del molino{line}{color:8095}n.° 7{color:809B} está como nuevo. ¿Quieres probarlo, kupó?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}J'ai changé les pièces rouillées du {color:8095}moulin n°7{color:8080}.{line}Il est comme neuf. Je l'arrête, kupo ?{line}{choice:2}[L'arrêter.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}C'erano dei pezzi da cambiare, ma ora dovrebbe{line}essere tutto a posto. Proviamo a fermarlo, kupò?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}部品を交換したから、風車の制動は簡単クポ。{line}{color:8095}第７号基{color:8080}を止めてみるクポ？{line}{choice:2}[停止させる|何もしない]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Have to finish my work. Mustn't upset the master.{line}{color:8095}No. 9{color:8080} of the lot of ten is my charge, kupo.

es: {name:A283E1}{line}Si no termino esto pronto, el capataz se{line}enfadará, kupó... Hay diez molinos en Cerobi,{line}y a mí me ha tocado reparar el {color:8095}n.° 9{color:809B}, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Il faut que je finisse mon travail ! Je ne voudrais{line}surtout pas contrarier le maître. Je dois réparer{line}le {color:8095}moulin n°9{color:8080} parmi les dix des plateaux, kupo.
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Se non mi sbrigo, chi lo sente il capomastro?{line}Sull'Altopiano di Cerobi ci sono dieci mulini, kupò.{line}Io aggiusto il numero {color:8095}9{color:8080}.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}早く整備を終わらせないと、親方に怒られるクポ……。{line}風車は、このセロビ台地に全部で10基クポ。{line}モグは{color:8095}第９号基{color:8080}の担当クポ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}빨리 정비를 마치지 않으면 사장님 화낸다 쿠뽀……{line}풍차는 이 세로비 대지에 총 10기 쿠뽀.{line}모그는 {color:8095}제9호기{color:8080}의 담당 쿠뽀.
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}要是不快点完成维修，可是会被工头骂的咕波……{line}这个榭洛比台地共有10座风车咕波。{line}莫古负责{color:8095}第９号机{color:8080}咕波。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}要是不快點完成維修，可是會被工頭罵的咕波……{line}這個榭洛比台地共有10座風車咕波。{line}莫古負責{color:8095}第９號機{color:8080}咕波。

us: {name:A283E1}{line}I'm more or less finished fixing up the windmill,{line}kupo. Just doing a few last minute checks.{page}This is the {color:8095}No. 9{color:8080} windmill, don't you know. It's{line}running right now...want me to stop it, kupo?{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]

Im Moment läuft{line}sie, aber ich kann sie auch anhalten.{line}{choice:2}[Anhalten|Drehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Pronto terminaré de reparar el molino, kupó.{line}Solo falta comprobar que esté todo en orden, kupó.{page}Este es el molino {color:8095}n.° 9{color:809B}, kupó. Está en marcha,{line}pero puedo detenerlo si quieres. ¿Kupopó?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}J'ai à peu près fini la révision du moulin, kupo.{line}Il ne me reste plus que quelques vérifications{line}de dernière minute à faire.{page}Ceci est le {color:8095}moulin n°9{color:8080}, au cas où vous l'auriez{line}oublié. Je l'arrête, kupo ?{line}{choice:2}[L'arrêter.|Ne rien faire.]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Kupo-po!? You shouldn't sneak up on people{line}like that! And what exactly are you doing up{line}there in the first place, kupo?
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Kupopopopo! Hast du mich aber erschreckt, Opa!{line}Wo kommst du denn her? Was machst du da? Und{line}überhaupt, wer bist du eigentlich, kupo!?
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡¿Kupopó?! ¡Qué susto, kupó!{line}Oye, ¿qué diablos haces ahí, kupó?
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Kupopo ?! Vous m'avez fait peur, kupo !{line}Mais qu'est-ce que vous faites là-haut, d'abord ?
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Kupò-pò-pò?! Che colpo!{line}E tu da dove salti fuori?{line}E, soprattutto, chi sei?
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}クポポポッ!?{blank}びっくりしたクポッ！{line}じいさん、どこから出てくるクポ！{line}それよりそもそも何者クポッ!?

cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}咕波波波！？吓我一跳咕波！{line}老爷爷，你是从哪里冒出来的咕波！？{line}而且你是谁啊咕波！？

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Small wonder my work on the windmill met with{line}so little success. You were more than dozing up{line}there, kupo. I'd say you were hibernating!{page}These people slew your vyraal while you were{line}sound asleep, kupo! I saw the whole thing!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Und ich hab hier geschraubt und geschraubt und{line}nichts tat sich. Das war also deine Schuld, Opa?{line}Weil du auf der Drehfelge geschlafen hast, kupo!?{page}Von wegen eingenickt! Winterschlaf nenn ich das!{line}Als du so kupo am Ratzen warst, haben {fixed-advance:8194}die da{fixed-advance:8180}{line}übrigens diesen Viraal erledigt!{page}Kann ich jetzt wohl endlich meine Arbeit zu{line}Ende führen? Kupo!?
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Ahora entiendo por qué el molino no quería{line}moverse, kupó! Claro, como te habías quedado{line}dormido encima de la rueda, kupó...{page}Mientras dormías, aquel chico ha despachado{line}a ese Vairal que tanto querías ver, kupó...{line}Yo no me he perdido nada de la acción, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Je comprends mieux pourquoi je n'arrivais à rien{line}avec ce moulin. Vous n'avez pas fait que vous{line}assoupir là-haut, kupo... vous avez hiberné !{page}Ces gens-là ont terrassé votre vyraal pendant{line}que vous dormiez et vous n'avez rien entendu,{line}kupo ! Je peux vous le dire, j'ai tout vu !
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Ecco perché non si muoveva, sei tu che{line}bloccavi tutto dormendo sulla pala, kupò!{line}Ma non avevi proprio altro posto?{page}Mentre dormivi, il tuo Viral è stato{line}abbattuto, sai? Io da qui ho visto tutto.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}いくら整備しても風車が動かなかったのは、{line}じいさんがリムの上で寝てたからクポ？{line}何がウトウトクポ！{blank}寝すぎクポ！{page}じいさんが寝てる間に、お探しのヴィラールって竜は{line}そこにいる人が退治しちゃったクポ！{line}モグはここから一部始終を見守っていたクポ！
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}아무리 정비해도 풍차가 안 움직인 건{line}할아버지가 림 위에서 잤기 때문 쿠뽀?{line}졸음 아님 쿠뽀! 너무 잤다 쿠뽀!{page}할아버지 자는 사이에, 비랄이라는 용은{line}저기 있는 사람이 퇴치해 버렸다 쿠뽀!{line}모그는 여기서 자초지종을 다 바라봤다 쿠뽀!
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}之所以不管我怎么维修，风车都不会动，{line}是因为老爷爷在转轮上面睡觉吗咕波？{line}什么打瞌睡啊咕波！你根本就是睡过头了咕波！{page}你要找的威拉尔，{line}在你睡着的期间，已经被那个人给击退了咕波！{line}莫古可是在这里亲眼见证了一切咕波！
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}之所以不管我怎麼維修，風車都不會動，{line}是因為老爺爺在轉輪上面睡覺嗎咕波？{line}什麼打瞌睡啊咕波！你根本就是睡過頭了咕波！{page}你要找的威拉爾，{line}在你睡著的期間，已經被那個人給擊退了咕波！{line}莫古可是在這裡親眼見證了一切咕波！

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Windmill {color:8095}No. 10{color:8080} of ten, up and running at last,{line}thanks in no small part to the absence of that{line}silly man, kupo.{page}Small wonder I couldn't repair the windmill,{line}with him sitting on the wheel the whole time.{line}Of all the places to sit, kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Dies ist {color:8095}Windmühle 10{color:8080}, kupo. Die letzte der zehn{line}Mühlen in der Cerobi-Steppe, kupo. Jetzt, da der{line}Hume-Opa weg ist, läuft sie endlich wieder.{page}Der doofe Opa lag nämlich auf der Drehfelge rum.{line}Darum hat sich hier nichts bewegt, kupo. Und ich{line}hatte schon an meinen Schraubkünsten gezweifelt!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Este es el molino {color:8095}n.° 10{color:809B} de los diez de Cerobi, kupó.{line}Ahora que se ha ido aquel viejito, podré ponerme{line}manos a la obra, kupó.{page}Con el viejito acostado sobre la rueda,{line}no había forma de que el molino se moviera, kupó.{line}¿A quién se le ocurre, kupopó?...
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Ça y est, le {color:8095}moulin n°10{color:8080} marche enfin !{line}Sûrement en grande partie parce que{line}l'autre crétin n'est plus là, kupo...{page}Il dormait sur la roue principale ! Pas étonnant{line}que le moulin ait été bloqué ! Franchement, il n'y{line}a pas de meilleur endroit pour dormir, kupo ?!
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Sull'Altopiano di Cerobi ci sono dieci mulini.{line}E questo è proprio il numero {color:8095}10{color:8080}, kupò.{page}Ora che quel signore non c'è più, posso lavorare.{line}Era seduto su una pala, ci credo che il mulino{line}non si muoveva!
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}この風車は、セロビ台地に10基ある風車のうちの{line}{color:8095}第10号基{color:8080}クポ。{line}あのじいさんがいなくなって、やっと整備できるクポ。{page}じいさんがリムに座っていたから、何をしても{line}風車が動かなかったクポ！{blank}迷惑なじいさんクポ！
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}이 풍차는 세로비 대지에 10기 있는 풍차 중{line}{color:8095}제10호기{color:8080} 쿠뽀.{line}그 할아버지가 없어져서 겨우 정비할 수 있다 쿠뽀.{page}할아버지가 림에 앉아 있었기 때문에, 뭘 해도{line}풍차가 안 움직였다 쿠뽀! 민폐 할아버지 쿠뽀!
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}这座风车是榭洛比台地{line}10座风车的{color:8095}第10号机{color:8080}咕波。{line}那个老爷爷不在，总算可以维修了咕波。{page}因为那个老爷爷坐在转轮上，所以不管怎么做，{line}风车都不会动咕波！真是给人添麻烦的老爷爷咕波！
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}這座風車是榭洛比台地{line}10座風車的{color:8095}第10號機{color:8080}咕波。{line}那個老爺爺不在，總算可以維修了咕波。{page}因為那個老爺爺坐在轉輪上，所以不管怎麼做，{line}風車都不會動咕波！真是給人添麻煩的老爺爺咕波！

us: {name:A283E1}{line}The Craftsmoogles' League was commissioned with{line}servicing the windmills on Cerobi Steppe, and{line}I'm in charge of this one, {color:8095}No. 10{color:8080}.{page}For some reason this is the only one that isn't{line}working. The other nine are happy as can be.{line}Did I break something, kupo?
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Die zehn Windmühlen in der Cerobi-Steppe werden{line}vom Mogry-Bauunternehmen gewartet, kupo. Ich{line}repariere {color:8095}Windmühle 10{color:8080}.{page}Doch ich bin mit meinem Mogry-Latein am Ende.{line}Diese Mühle will sich einfach nicht drehen, kupo!{line}Meister Mogrowsky zieht mir den Bommel lang!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Los Mogulaboriosos estamos poniendo a punto{line}los diez molinos de Cerobi, uno cada uno, kupó.{line}A mí me ha tocado el {color:8095}n.° 10{color:809B}, kupó.{page}No sé por qué, pero no logro que se mueva, kupó.{line}¡Los otros nueve funcionan sin problemas, kupó!{line}¿Habré metido la pata, kupopó?...
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}La Compagnie des Mogs a été chargée de la révision{line}des moulins des plateaux de Cérobi. Je m'occupe{line}de celui-ci, le {color:8095}moulin n°10{color:8080}, kupo.{page}Bizarrement, c'est le seul qui ne marche pas.{line}Le neuf autres fonctionnent parfaitement.{line}Aurais-je cassé quelque chose, kupo ?
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Sull'Altopiano di Cerobi ci sono dieci mulini{line}e l'Edilmogu deve aggiustarli tutti, kupò.{line}Io mi occupo di questo, il numero {color:8095}10{color:8080}.{page}Non so come mai... è l'unico che non funziona.{line}Gli altri nove non hanno problemi. Chissà perché?{line}Non avrò mica sbagliato qualcosa?
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}このセロビ台地には10基の風車があって、{line}モーグリ工務店の仲間と分担して整備中クポ。{line}モグの担当は、この{color:8095}第10号基{color:8080}クポ。{page}……なぜか、この風車だけが動いてくれないクポ。{line}他の風車９基は順調に作動するのにどうしてクポ？{line}モグ、何か悪いことしたクポ～？
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}이 세로비 대지에는 10기의 풍차가 있어서,{line}모그리 공무점의 동료들과 분담해서 정비 중 쿠뽀.{line}모그의 담당은 이 {color:8095}제10호기{color:8080} 쿠뽀.{page}……왠지 이 풍차만 움직이지 않는다 쿠뽀.{line}다른 풍차 9기는 순조로이 작동하는데 어째서 쿠뽀?{line}모그, 뭔가 나쁜 짓 했었나 쿠뽀~?
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}这个榭洛比台地有10座风车，{line}莫古利工务店的伙伴正分别进行维修咕波。{line}莫古负责的是这座{color:8095}第10号机{color:8080}咕波。{page}……为什么就只有这座风车不会动咕波？{line}其他９座风车都很顺利转动，到底是为什么咕波？{line}莫古做了什么坏事吗咕波～？
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}這個榭洛比台地有10座風車，{line}莫古利工務店的夥伴正分別進行維修咕波。{line}莫古負責的是這座{color:8095}第10號機{color:8080}咕波。{page}……為什麼就只有這座風車不會動咕波？{line}其他９座風車都很順利轉動，到底是為什麼咕波？{line}莫古做了什麼壞事嗎咕波～？

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Just have a little fine tuning left to do and{line}{color:8095}No. 10{color:8080} will be good as new. Want me to stop it?{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Die Arbeiten an {color:8095}Windmühle 10{color:8080} sind so gut wie{line}abgeschlossen. Ich führe letzte Tests durch ...{page}Soll ich die drehende Mühle mal anhalten, kupo?{line}{choice:2}[Anhalten|Drehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}El molino {color:8095}n.° 10{color:809B} ya está listo; ahora lo estoy{line}probando, kupó. ¿Quieres ver cómo lo detengo?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Je suis en train de finir de régler le {color:8095}moulin n°10{color:8080}.{line}Vous voulez que je l'arrête, kupo ?{line}{choice:2}[L'arrêter.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Il mulino {color:8095}10{color:8080} è quasi pronto. Sto facendo{line}l'ultimo controllo, kupò.{page}Proviamo a farlo fermare?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}この{color:8095}第10号基{color:8080}の整備もほぼ終わって、最終チェック中クポ。{line}動いている風車が止まるところを見るクポ？{line}{choice:2}[停止させる|何もしない]
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}이 {color:8095}제10호기{color:8080}의 정비도 거의 끝나고, 최종점검 중 쿠뽀.{line}움직이는 풍차가 멈추는 걸 볼 거 쿠뽀?{line}{choice:2}[정지시킨다|아무것도 안 한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}这座{color:8095}第10号机{color:8080}的维修几乎结束了，正在进行最终确认咕波。{line}要把转动的风车停下来吗咕波？{line}{choice:2}[停止|什么都不做]
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}這座{color:8095}第10號機{color:8080}的維修幾乎結束了，正在進行最終確認咕波。{line}要把轉動的風車停下來嗎咕波？{line}{choice:2}[停止|什麼都不做]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}I'll have it stopped before you know it.{line}Just a moment, kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Okay, dauert nur ein Sekündchen, kupo!{line}Bin schon dabei ...
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Estará quieto en menos que canta{line}una cocatriz, kupó!
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Je vais l'arrêter en moins de deux.{line}Juste une seconde, kupo !
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}モグにお任せクポ！{line}ちょっと待ってるクポ～。
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}交给莫古吧咕波！{line}稍等一下咕波～
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}交給莫古吧咕波！{line}稍等一下咕波～

us: {name:A283E1}{line}There you go! Stopped as stopped can be, kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Sehr gut, rührt sich kein Stück, kupo! Wie{line}ein dicker Seek am Strand von Phon ...
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Listo, kupó! ¡Ya no se mueve, kupó!
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Et voilà le travail, kupo !
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}よし！{blank}これで止まったクポ！
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}好！这样就停下来了咕波！
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}好！這樣就停下來了咕波！

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Oh, all right. Let me know if you need me to stop{line}it for you, kupo.
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Och, wirklich? Bei Interesse führ ich{line}es jederzeit gerne vor, kupo.
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Vale, kupó... Cuando quieras verlo,{line}aquí estaré esperando, kupó...
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Ah... bon. Si vous avez besoin que je l'arrête,{line}tenez-moi au courant, kupo.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}そうクポ？{line}見たくなったら、またおいでクポ。
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}是吗咕波？{line}要是想看的话再过来吧咕波。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}是嗎咕波？{line}要是想看的話再過來吧咕波。

de: {name:A283E1}{line}Die Arbeiten an {color:8095}Windmühle 10{color:8080} sind so gut wie{line}abgeschlossen. Ich führe letzte Tests durch ...{page}Soll ich die stehende Mühle mal anwerfen, kupo?{line}{choice:2}[In Gang setzen|Still stehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}El molino {color:8095}n.° 10{color:809B} ya está listo; ahora lo estoy{line}probando, kupó. ¿Quieres que lo ponga en marcha?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Je suis en train de finir de régler le {color:8095}moulin n°10{color:8080}.{line}Vous voulez que je le mette en route, kupo ?{line}{choice:2}[Le mettre en route.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Il mulino {color:8095}10{color:8080} è quasi pronto. Sto facendo{line}l'ultimo controllo, kupò.{page}Proviamo a farlo partire?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}この{color:8095}第10号基{color:8080}の整備もほぼ終わって、最終チェック中クポ。{line}止まってる風車が動き出すところを見るクポ？{line}{choice:2}[動かす|何もしない]

cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}这座{color:8095}第10号机{color:8080}的维修几乎结束了，正在进行最终确认咕波。{line}要把停止的风车进行转动吗咕波？{line}{choice:2}[转动|什么都不做]
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}這座{color:8095}第10號機{color:8080}的維修幾乎結束了，正在進行最終確認咕波。{line}要把停止的風車進行轉動嗎咕波？{line}{choice:2}[轉動|什麼都不做]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}I'll have it started before you know it.{line}Just a moment, kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Okay, dauert nur ein Sekündchen, kupo!{line}Bin schon dabei ...
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Estará en marcha en menos que canta{line}una cocatriz, kupó!

us: {name:A283E1}{line}There you go! Running right along, it is! Kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Okay, flitzt wie ein Chocobo zum Gizar-Kraut-{line}Feld, kupo!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Listo, kupó! ¡Ha arrancado, kupó!
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Et voilà le travail, kupo !

cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}好！这样就开始转动了咕波！
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}好！這樣就開始轉動了咕波！

es: {name:A283E1}{line}Vale, kupó... Cuando quieras verlo,{line}aquí estaré esperando, kupó...
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Ah... bon. Si vous avez besoin que je le mette{line}en route, tenez-moi au courant, kupo.

ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}是嗎咕波？{line}要是想看的話再過來吧咕波。

us: {name:828499}{line}Who's been making all that noise?
de: {name:828499}{line}Huch! Was ist dies für ein Klappern und Poltern?{line}Wie soll ich denn bei diesem Lärm forschen!?
es: {name:828499}{line}¡Caray! ¿Quién está ahí haciendo bulla?
fr: {name:828499}{line}Qui est-ce qui fait tout ce bruit ?
in: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}なんじゃい？{line}さっきから、がちゃがちゃ騒々しいのう！
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}做什么？{line}从刚刚就喀锵喀锵地吵死人了！
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}做什麼？{line}從剛剛就喀鏘喀鏘地吵死人了！

us: {name:828499}{line}I'm observing! A natural philosopher must always{line}observe. I came here to observe a rare breed of{line}wyrm called the vyraal.{page}The top of this windmill seemed the perfect spot{line}for my observations, but...I suppose I must have{line}dozed off.
de: {name:828499}{line}Hoho, Kleiner. Ein gar freches Mundwerk hast du{line}aber! Mein Forschungsgebiet sind ivalisische Dra-{line}chen. Ich hörte, dass sich der legendäre Viraal{page}hier aufhalten soll und kam, mich zu überzeugen.{line}Oben von der Mühle hielt ich Ausschau nach ihm.{line}Ei der Daus, scheinbar bin ich hier eingenickt!
es: {name:828499}{line}He venido en busca de un dragón legendario,{line}el Vairal... Oí que aparecía por aquí y me había{line}apostado en este molino para observarlo.{page}Pero me ha dado un poco de modorra...
fr: {name:828499}{line}J'observe ! Un philosophe naturaliste doit{line}toujours observer. Je suis venu ici pour{line}étudier une espèce rare de dragon, le vyraal.{page}Le toit de ce moulin m'a semblé être l'endroit{line}idéal pour effectuer mes observations, mais à{line}vrai dire... je crois que je me suis assoupi !
it: {name:828499}{line}Faccio ricerca sui draghi di Ivalice.{line}Ho saputo che in zona è stato avvistato Viral,{line}il leggendario drago, e così mi sono appostato qui.{page}Ohi ohi ohi! Mi ero appena addormentato.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}ふっ……ワシはイヴァリースの竜について研究しておる！{line}この近辺に伝説の竜ヴィラールが現れるとの情報を得て、{line}風車の上で張り込んでおったのだ。{page}むむ……？{line}おやおや、少々ウトウトしてしまったようじゃな。
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}훗…… 나는 이발리스의 용에 대해 연구하고 있다!{line}이 근처에 전설의 용 비랄이 나타난다는 정보를 얻어{line}풍차 위에서 감시 중이었다.{page}으음……?{line}이런이런, 약간 졸았던 모양이군.
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}呼……我在对伊瓦利斯的龙进行研究！{line}我听说这附近出现传说中的龙威拉尔，{line}所以在风车上监视。{page}唔唔……？{line}哎呀呀，看来我有点打瞌睡了啊。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}呼……我在對伊瓦利斯的龍進行研究！{line}我聽說這附近出現傳說中的龍威拉爾，{line}所以在風車上監視。{page}唔唔……？{line}哎呀呀，看來我有點打瞌睡了啊。

us: {name:828499}{line}What's this!? You killed the vyraal!?
de: {name:828499}{line}Wi-wie bitte? Was sagst du, flauschiger Freund?{line}Viraal wurde niedergestreckt? {fixed-advance:8194}Mein{fixed-advance:8180} Viraal!?
es: {name:828499}{line}¡¿Quééé?! ¡¿Has matado al Vairal?!
fr: {name:828499}{line}Comment ?! Vous avez tué le vyraal ?!
in: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}んなっ!?{blank}なんじゃと!?{line}ヴィラールを倒してしまったのか!?
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}啊！？你说什么！？{line}威拉尔被打倒了吗！？
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}啊！？你說什麼！？{line}威拉爾被打倒了嗎！？

us: {name:828499}{line}How long I searched for it, only to fall asleep{line}when it finally appeared!{page}The years must be catching up with me. How could{line}I let this happen? Maybe I'm getting too old for{line}this...
de: {name:828499}{line}Du liebe Güte! Das darf doch nicht wahr sein!{line}Jahrelang verfolge ich diesen Drachen und dann{line}verschlafe ich sein Auftreten und Ableben?{page}Mir scheint, ich bin langsam reif für 's Greisenheim.{line}Keinen Wert hat mein Leben mehr! Ach, soll'n sie{line}mich doch auch als Mob ausschreiben ...
es: {name:828499}{line}¡Lo he buscado tanto tiempo, y me quedo{line}dormido justo cuando lo están matando!{page}Algo me dice que ya no estoy para estos{line}trotes... Quizá deba retirarme de la{line}investigación activa.
fr: {name:828499}{line}Je l'ai cherché pendant tout ce temps pour...{line}pour m'endormir au moment où il sort enfin{line}de sa tanière ?!{page}Comment ai-je pu laisser une chose pareille{line}arriver ? Je me fais peut-être vieux...
it: {name:828499}{line}Ma non è possibile! Tutti questi anni spesi{line}a cercarlo e quando finalmente si fa vedere{line}io cosa faccio? Dormo! Sono... sono disperato!
in: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}なんたることよ……長年追ってきたヴィラールが現れ、{line}倒される現場にいながら居眠りしてしまうとは！{page}焼きが回ったとは、このことか……。{line}ぬうう……もはやワシも引退すべき時か……。
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}대체 무슨 일인가…… 오랫동안 추적해 온 비랄이 나타났는데,{line}쓰러뜨리는 현장에 있으면서 졸아 버렸다니!{page}늙었다는게 이런 걸 말하는 건가……{line}으으으…… 이제 나도 은퇴해야 할 때인가……
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}怎么会这样……长年追逐的威拉尔出现，{line}而我就在它被打倒的现场，结果却睡着了！{page}这就是所谓上了年纪吗……{line}唔唔唔……看来我也该退休了……
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}怎麼會這樣……長年追逐的威拉爾出現，{line}而我就在牠被打倒的現場，結果卻睡著了！{page}這就是所謂上了年紀嗎……{line}呣唔唔……看來我也該引退了……

us: {name:828499}{line}Just a moment... What's that you have there?{page}Is that...? Could it be...? A vyraal scale!{line}And who better in all of Ivalice to recognize{line}it for the treasure it is than I!{page}Please, I must have that {color:8092}dragon scale{color:8080}!{line}{choice:2}[Give him the scale.|Keep the scale.]
de: {name:828499}{line}Huch? Du hast da ... Ja, das sind doch nicht{line}etwa ... Ja, das werden doch wohl nicht ...?{page}Donnerschlag und Kieselstein! Schuppen Viraals!{line}Ihren Wert zu schätzen, vermag zweifelsfrei auf{line}ganz Ivalice ich am besten!{page}Ich bitte dich! Überlasse mir die {color:8092}Drachenschuppen{color:8080}!{line}{choice:2}[Abgeben|Behalten]
es: {name:828499}{line}Espera..., ¿qué tienes ahí?{line}¿Acaso no será...?{page}¡Sí, es una escama del Vairal!{line}Nadie en Ivalice conoce mejor que yo el valor{line}de eso que tienes en tus manos, muchacho.{page}Te lo ruego...{line}¡Esa {color:8091}Escama de dragón{color:8080} tiene que ser mía!{line}{choice:2}[Darle la escama.|Negarse.]
fr: {name:828499}{line}Attendez, mais... qu'est-ce que vous avez là ?{page}Est-ce... une écaille de vyraal ?!{line}Oh, vous ne pouvez pas imaginer{line}la valeur qu'a ce trésor à mes yeux !{page}De grâce, donnez-moi cette {color:8092}écaille de vyraal{color:8080} !{line}{choice:2}[La lui donner.|La garder.]
it: {name:828499}{line}Cosa vedono i miei occhi!{page}Quella è... è una squama di Viral!{line}Nessuno meglio di me ne conosce il valore.{page}Ti prego, dammi la {color:8092}Squama di drago{color:8080}!{line}{choice:2}[Cedo la Squama.|Rifiuto.]
in: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}ふぬっ？{line}おぬしが持っているそれは、もしや……？{page}おお、ヴィラールのうろこではないか！{line}……その品の価値をイヴァリースの誰よりも{line}よく知っておるのは、何を隠そうこのワシじゃ！{page}頼む！{blank}その{color:8092}竜のうろこ{color:8080}、ゆずってはくれぬか！{line}{choice:2}[ゆずる|断る]
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}으음?{line}자네가 가지고 있는 그건, 설마……?{page}오오, 비랄의 비늘 아닌가!{line}……그 물건의 가치를 이발리스의 누구보다{line}잘 아는 건, 딴 사람도 아닌 바로 나!{page}부탁하네! 그 {color:8092}용의 비늘{color:8080}, 내게 양보해 주지 않겠나!{line}{choice:2}[양보한다|거절한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}呼唔？{line}你手上拿的那个，该不会是……？{page}喔喔，这不是威拉尔的鳞吗！？{line}……在伊瓦利斯中，{line}最能理解这东西价值的非我莫属！{page}拜托你！可以把那个{color:8092}龙鳞{color:8080}让给我吗！？{line}{choice:2}[让出|拒绝]
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}呼唔？{line}你手上拿的那個，該不會是……？{page}喔喔，這不是威拉爾的鱗嗎！？{line}……在伊瓦利斯中，{line}最能理解這東西價值的非我莫屬！{page}拜託你！可以把那個{color:8092}龍鱗{color:8080}讓給我嗎！？{line}{choice:2}[出讓|拒絕]

us: {name:828499}{line}Thank you! Thank you so much! My life's work is{line}complete! I shall treasure this for the rest of my{line}days.{page}I must give you something by way of thanks...{line}Here, take this. It is a key said to open the door{line}to a chamber holding a most terrible wyrm.
de: {name:828499}{line}Juchheisa und Gloria! Mein Dank wird ewig wäh-{line}ren! So habe ich auf meine alten Tage doch noch{line}meinen Frieden gefunden. Bis an mein Lebensende{page}werde ich den Anblick dieser prächtigen Schuppen{line}genießen. O, verzeih! Auch du sollst nicht leer{line}ausgehen. Nimm diesen Schlüssel.{page}Er soll die Türe zum Hort des Königs aller{line}Drachen öffnen.
es: {name:828499}{line}¡Gracias, gracias! Ahora podré retirarme{line}con el espíritu en paz. La escama del Vairal{line}iluminará el resto de mis días.{page}Quiero retribuírtelo de alguna manera...{line}Toma esta llave. Dicen que abre una puerta{line}que encierra al más terrible de los dragones.
fr: {name:828499}{line}Merci ! Merci mille fois ! Mon œuvre est maintenant{line}accomplie ! Je vais chérir ce trésor jusqu'à la fin{line}de mes jours.{page}Je tiens à vous donner quelque chose en retour.{line}Tenez, prenez ceci. C'est une clé censée ouvrir la{line}porte d'une chambre abritant un terrible dragon.
it: {name:828499}{line}Io... non so come ringraziarvi!{line}Ora posso andarmene in pensione senza rimpianti.{line}Passerò le mie giornate ammirando il mio tesoro.{page}Voglio dimostrarvi la mia gratitudine:{line}vi regalo questa chiave. È per aprire la porta{line}che sigilla il drago più potente.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}おおっ！{blank}ありがたい！{line}これでワシも引退できるというものじゃ……。{line}ヴィラールのうろこを眺めて余生を過ごすとしよう。{page}そうだ、おぬしに礼をせねばならん。{line}……このカギを受け取ってくれい。{line}究極の竜を封じ込めたといわれる扉のカギじゃよ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}오오! 고맙군!{line}이제야 은퇴할 수 있게 됐어……{line}비랄의 비늘을 바라보며 여생을 보내도록 하지.{page}그래, 자네에게 답례를 해야지.{line}……이 열쇠를 받아 주게.{line}궁극의 용을 봉인했다는 문의 열쇠라네.
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}喔喔！太感谢你了！{line}这样我也能安心退休……{line}就看着威拉尔之鳞度过余生吧。{page}对了，也得给你回礼才行。{line}……收下这把钥匙吧。{line}据说是封印终极之龙的门扉钥匙。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}喔喔！太感謝你了！{line}這樣我也能安心引退……{line}就看著威拉爾之鱗度過餘生吧。{page}對了，也得給你回禮才行。{line}……收下這把鑰匙吧。{line}據說是封印終極之龍的門扉鑰匙。

us: {name:828499}{line}The legendry makes mention of the wyrm's{line}ferocity, but not its whereabouts.{page}I'm sure one who could find and slay a vyraal will{line}have no difficulty finding and slaying this wyrm.{line}Pray let it be a glorious battle. Farewell!
de: {name:828499}{line}Der ultimative Drache, der König aller Drachen!{line}Wo er sich verbirgt, ist selbst mir nicht be-{line}kannt. Doch für dich, der du Viraal erlegtest,{page}wird auch diese Herausforderung zu meistern sein!{line}Gehe nun, finde dein Glück. Meine Gebete werden{line}dich begleiten ...
es: {name:828499}{line}No sé dónde está ese dragón, pero si tú has{line}hallado y matado al Vairal, no dudo que podrás{line}hacer lo mismo con esta otra criatura.{page}Adiós, valiente joven.{line}¡Que sea una batalla gloriosa!
fr: {name:828499}{line}La légende évoque la férocité de ce dragon,{line}mais pas l'endroit où il se tapit.{page}Ceci dit, quelqu'un qui a terrassé un vyraal ne{line}devrait avoir aucun mal à dénicher ce dragon.{line}Que ce soit pour vous un glorieux combat ! Adieu !
it: {name:828499}{line}Non so dove sia, ma voi che avete sconfitto{line}Viral sicuramente saprete come trovarlo.{line}Addio, allora. Continuate così!
in: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}究極の竜とやらが、どこにおるかはワシも知らんが、{line}ヴィラールを退治したおぬしなら倒せるはずじゃ。{line}……さらばじゃ、若人よ。健闘を祈っておるぞ！
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}궁극의 용이라는 게 어디 있는지는 나도 모르지만,{line}비랄을 퇴치한 자네라면 쓰러뜨릴 수 있을 걸세.{line}……그럼 잘 있게, 젊은이. 건투를 비네!
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}我也不知道那个终极之龙在哪里，{line}但击退威拉尔的你应该可以打倒它。{line}……再见了，年轻人。祝你顺利！
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}我也不知道那個終極之龍在哪裡，{line}但擊退威拉爾的你應該可以打倒牠。{line}……再見了，年輕人。祝你順利！

us: {name:828499}{line}I beg of you! You wouldn't deny the last wish of{line}an aged philosopher, would you?{page}Pray, give me the {color:8092}dragon scale{color:8080}!{line}{choice:2}[Give him the scale.|Keep the scale.]
de: {name:828499}{line}Ich flehe dich an! Erfülle einem alten Manne,{line}dessen Lebensweg nicht mehr lang, seinen Her-{line}zenswunsch, auf dass er in Ruhe sterben kann!{page}Bitte, überlass {fixed-advance:8194}mir{fixed-advance:8180} die {color:8092}Drachenschuppen{color:8080}!{line}{choice:2}[Abgeben|Behalten]
es: {name:828499}{line}¡Por lo que más quieras, hijo!{line}¡Es el último deseo de este viejo!{page}¡Por favor, dame la {color:8091}Escama de dragón{color:8080}!{line}{choice:2}[Darle la escama.|Negarse.]
fr: {name:828499}{line}Je vous en supplie ! Vous n'allez tout de même{line}pas refuser la dernière volonté d'un honorable{line}draconologiste ?{page}Pitié, donnez-moi votre {color:8092}écaille de vyraal{color:8080} !{line}{choice:2}[La lui donner.|La garder.]
it: {name:828499}{line}Te lo chiedo in ginocchio. Fallo per me,{line}un povero vecchio cui resta poco da vivere.{page}Ti scongiuro, dammi la {color:8092}Squama di drago{color:8080}!{line}{choice:2}[Cedo la Squama.|Rifiuto.]
in: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}そこをなんとか！{blank}老い先短いワシへ贈る{line}冥土の土産ということで、どうかどうか！{page}頼むから{color:8092}竜のうろこ{color:8080}をゆずってくれい！{line}{choice:2}[ゆずる|断る]
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}어떻게 좀 봐주게! 갈 날이 얼마 남지 않은 내게 주는{line}저승길 선물인 셈 치고 제발 제발!{page}부탁이니 {color:8092}용의 비늘{color:8080}을 양보해 주게!{line}{choice:2}[양보한다|거절한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}真的拜托你！就当作是送给我这个年迈老人{line}带去黄泉的礼物！{page}求求你，把{color:8092}龙鳞{color:8080}让给我！{line}{choice:2}[让出|拒绝]
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:828499}{line}真的拜託你！就當作是送給我這個年邁老人{line}帶去黃泉的禮物！{page}求求你，把{color:8092}龍鱗{color:8080}讓給我！{line}{choice:2}[出讓|拒絕]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}The Craftsmoogles' League have been called in to{line}service all ten of the windmills on the Steppe,{line}kupo. This is the {color:8095}No. 1{color:8080} mill.
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Das Mogry-Bauunternehmen kümmert sich um die{line}Wartung der Mühlen, kupo. Es gibt derer zehn in{line}der Cerobi-Steppe. Dieses ist {color:8095}Windmühle 1{color:8080}, kupo.
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Nos han encargado a los Mogulaboriosos el{line}mantenimiento de los molinos, kupó. En Cerobi{line}hay diez molinos, y este es el {color:8095}n.° 1{color:809B}, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}On a fait appel à la Compagnie des Mogs pour{line}réviser les dix moulins à vent de Cérobi, kupo.{line}Ceci est le {color:8095}moulin n°1{color:8080}.
it: {name:A283E1}{line}L'Edilmogu deve riparare i mulini, kupò.{line}Qui sull'Altopiano di Cerobi ce ne sono dieci.{line}Questo è il numero {color:8095}1{color:8080}.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}モーグリ工務店は風車の整備を引き受けたクポ。{line}ちなみにセロビ台地の風車は全10基クポ。{line}この風車は{color:8095}第１号基{color:8080}クポ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}모그리 공무점은 풍차 정비 의뢰를 받았다 쿠뽀.{line}참고로 세로비 대지의 풍차는 총 10기다 쿠뽀.{line}이 풍차는 {color:8095}제1호기{color:8080} 쿠뽀.
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}莫古利工务店承接风车的维修工作咕波。{line}附带一提，榭洛比台地的风车共有10座咕波。{line}这座风车是{color:8095}第１号机{color:8080}咕波。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}莫古利工務店承接風車的維修工作咕波。{line}附帶一提，榭洛比台地的風車共有10座咕波。{line}這座風車是{color:8095}第１號機{color:8080}咕波。

us: {name:A283E1}{line}This is the {color:8095}No. 1{color:8080} mill, kupo. She's running right{line}now...need me to stop her?{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Dies ist {color:8095}Windmühle 1{color:8080}, kupo. Sie dreht sich{line}im Moment. Soll ich sie anhalten?{line}{choice:2}[Anhalten|Drehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Este es el molino n.° 1, kupó.{line}Está en movimiento; ¿quieres que lo detenga, kupó?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Ceci est le {color:8095}moulin n°1{color:8080}, kupo. Il tourne,{line}pour le moment. Vous voulez que je l'arrête ?{line}{choice:2}[L'arrêter.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Questo è il mulino {color:8095}1{color:8080}, kupò.{line}Ora è in funzione. Lo volete fermare?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}この風車は{color:8095}第１号基{color:8080}クポ。{line}今は動いているけど、止めたいクポ？{line}{choice:2}[停止させる|何もしない]
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}이 풍차는 {color:8095}제1호기{color:8080} 쿠뽀.{line}지금 움직이는데, 멈추고 싶냐 쿠뽀?{line}{choice:2}[정지시킨다|아무것도 안 한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}这座风车是{color:8095}第１号机{color:8080}咕波。{line}现在正在转动，要停下来吗咕波？{line}{choice:2}[停止|什么都不做]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Right away, kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Alles kupo!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Ya mismo, kupó!
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Tout de suite, kupo !

ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}知道了咕波！

us: {name:A283E1}{line}That's stopped it, kupo!

in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}見事に止まったクポ！
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}顺利停止了咕波！

es: {name:A283E1}{line}¿De verdad no quieres, kupó?{line}¡Qué aburrido, kupó!
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Ne rien faire ? Vraiment, kupo ?{line}Mais c'est pas drôle, ça !
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}やらなくていいクポ？{line}つまんないクポ……。
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}不用吗咕波？{line}真无趣咕波……
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}不用嗎咕波？{line}真無趣咕波……

us: {name:A283E1}{line}This is the {color:8095}No. 1{color:8080} mill, kupo. She's stopped right{line}now...need me to start her up?{line}{choice:2}[Start the windmill.|Do nothing.]
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Dies ist {color:8095}Windmühle 1{color:8080}, kupo. Im Moment steht{line}sie still. Soll ich sie in Gang setzen?{line}{choice:2}[In Gang setzen|Still stehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Este es el molino {color:8095}n.° 1{color:809B}, kupó. Está detenido;{line}¿quieres que lo ponga en movimiento, kupó?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Ceci est le {color:8095}moulin n°1{color:8080}, kupo. Il est arrêté, pour{line}le moment. Vous voulez que je le mette en route ?{line}{choice:2}[Le mettre en route.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Questo è il mulino {color:8095}1{color:8080}, kupò.{line}Ora è fermo. Volete farlo partire?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Hello again, kupo! Got us working on windmills{line}now. I'm in charge of {color:8095}No. 2{color:8080} here. We've split the{line}ten mills up among the League.
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Hey, lange nicht gesehen, kupo! Diesmal sind wir{line}mit der Wartung der Windmühlen beschäftigt.{line}Ich kümmer mich um {color:8095}Windmühle 2{color:8080}, die restlichen{page}neun übernehmen meine Kollegen, kupo.
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Hola, kupó! Estamos trabajando en los molinos,{line}kupó. A mí me ha tocado el {color:8095}n.° 2{color:809B}, kupó. Cada{line}Mogulaborioso se ocupa de uno de los diez, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Oh, c'est vous ? Notre compagnie travaille sur les{line}moulins, maintenant. Moi, je suis responsable du{line}{color:8095}moulin n°2{color:8080}, kupo !
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Chi si rivede! Stiamo riparando i mulini, kupò.{line}Io mi occupo del numero {color:8095}2{color:8080}.{line}Tra tutti dobbiamo aggiustarne dieci.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}また会ったクポ！{blank}今度は風車の整備クポ～。{line}モグの担当は、この{color:8095}第２号基{color:8080}クポ。{line}10基の風車を、仲間と手分けして整備してるクポ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}또 만났구나 쿠뽀! 이번에는 풍차 정비 쿠뽀~.{line}모그의 담당은 이 {color:8095}제2호기{color:8080} 쿠뽀.{line}10기의 풍차를 동료와 분담해서 정비하고 있다 쿠뽀.
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}又见到你了咕波！这次是进行风车的维修咕波～{line}莫古负责的是这座{color:8095}第２号机{color:8080}咕波。{line}我们这些伙伴们分头进行10座风车的维修咕波。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}又見到你了咕波！這次是進行風車的維修咕波～{line}莫古負責的是這座{color:8095}第２號機{color:8080}咕波。{line}我們這些夥伴們分頭進行10座風車的維修咕波。

us: {name:A283E1}{line}I've got the {color:8095}No. 2{color:8080} mill in tip-top shape, kupo.{line}Need me to stop it for you?{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]
de: {name:A283E1}{line}{color:8095}Windmühle 2{color:8080} ist wieder in Schuss!{line}Soll ich mal zeigen, wie ich sie anhalte?{line}{choice:2}[Anhalten|Drehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}He puesto el molino {color:8095}n.° 2{color:809B} a punto, kupó.{line}¿Quieres que lo detenga, kupó?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Le {color:8095}moulin n°2{color:8080} marche comme sur des roulettes,{line}kupo. Vous voulez que je l'arrête ?{line}{choice:2}[L'arrêter.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Il mulino {color:8095}2{color:8080} è a posto, kupò.{line}Volete provare a fermarlo?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}The Craftsmoogles' League is servicing the wind-{line}mills on Cerobi Steppe, kupo. We're stretched thin{line}working on all ten. This is {color:8095}No. 3{color:8080}, kupo.
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Wir vom Mogry-Bauunternehmen halten die Müh-{line}len schüssig, kupo. Insgesamt gibt es zehn in der{line}Cerobi-Steppe. Dies ist {color:8095}Windmühle 3{color:8080}, kupo.
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Los Mogulaboriosos estamos poniendo a punto los{line}molinos, kupó. Aquí en Cerobi hay diez molinos;{line}uno para cada uno, kupó. Este es el {color:8095}n.° 3{color:809B}, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}La Compagnie des Mogs révise les moulins à vent{line}de Cérobi. Chacun de nous s'occupe de l'un d'eux.{line}Ceci est le {color:8095}moulin n°3{color:8080}, kupo.
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Siamo tutti qui perché dobbiamo riparare{line}i mulini, kupò. Ce ne sono dieci sull'Altopiano{line}di Cerobi. Questo è il numero {color:8095}3{color:8080}.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}工務店のみんなと手分けして風車を整備してるクポ。{line}セロビ台地には10基も風車があって整備が大変クポ。{line}この風車は{color:8095}第３号基{color:8080}クポ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}공무점의 모두와 분담해서 풍차를 정비하고 있다 쿠뽀.{line}세로비 대지에는 풍차가 10기나 있어서 정비하기도 힘들다 쿠뽀.{line}이 풍차는 {color:8095}제3호기{color:8080} 쿠뽀.
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}跟工务店的大家一起分头维修风车咕波。{line}榭洛比台地有10座风车，维修起来真的很辛苦咕波。{line}这座风车是{color:8095}第３号机{color:8080}咕波。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}跟工務店的大家一起分頭維修風車咕波。{line}榭洛比台地有10座風車，維修起來真的很辛苦咕波。{line}這座風車是{color:8095}第３號機{color:8080}咕波。

us: {name:A283E1}{line}The {color:8095}No. 3{color:8080} mill is in proper working order, kupo.{line}It's moving now, but I can stop it. Really!{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]

es: {name:A283E1}{line}Me han encargado el molino {color:8095}n.° 3{color:809B}; ahora está{line}en movimiento, pero ¿quieres que lo pare, kupó?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]

ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}唔……了解咕波……

us: {name:A283E1}{line}How have you been, kupo? We're servicing the{line}windmills of Cerobi Steppe. This is {color:8095}No. 4{color:8080} of{line}ten of the finest 'mills you ever did see, kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Oh, so trifft man sich wieder, kupo! Meine Kollegen{line}und ich warten jetzt die zehn Windmühlen in der{line}Cerobi-Steppe. Dies ist {color:8095}Windmühle 4{color:8080}, kupo.
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Dichosos los ojos! Estamos poniendo a punto{line}los molinos, kupó. Este es el {color:8095}n.° 4{color:809B}, kupó.{line}En Cerobi hay diez en total, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Comment ça va, kupo ? Nous révisons les moulins{line}à vent des plateaux de Cérobi. Celui-ci est le{line}{color:8095}moulin n°4{color:8080}. Il est beau, hein, kupo ?
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Quanto tempo! Stiamo riparando i mulini, kupò.{line}Questo è il numero {color:8095}4{color:8080}. Sull'Altopiano di Cerobi{line}ce ne sono dieci.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}久しぶりクポ。モグたち、今は風車を整備してるクポ。{line}この風車は{color:8095}第４号基{color:8080}クポ。{line}セロビ台地の風車は全部で10基あるクポ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}오랜만 쿠뽀. 모그들, 지금은 풍차 정비 중 쿠뽀.{line}이 풍차는 {color:8095}제4호기{color:8080} 쿠뽀.{line}세로비 대지의 풍차는 총 10기다 쿠뽀.
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}好久不见咕波。莫古们正在维修风车咕波。{line}这座风车是{color:8095}第４号机{color:8080}咕波。{line}榭洛比台地的风车共有10座咕波。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}好久不見咕波。莫古們正在維修風車咕波。{line}這座風車是{color:8095}第４號機{color:8080}咕波。{line}榭洛比台地的風車共有10座咕波。

us: {name:A283E1}{line}The {color:8095}No. 4{color:8080} windmill's in perfect order. I can stop{line}it whenever I like. Would you like to see, kupo?{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]
de: {name:A283E1}{line}{color:8095}Windmühle 4{color:8080} lässt sich jetzt jederzeit problemlos{line}anhalten. Soll ich 's mal demonstrieren, kupo?{line}{choice:2}[Anhalten|Drehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}El molino {color:8095}n.° 4{color:809B} está en perfectas condiciones, kupó.{line}¿Quieres que lo pare para probarlo, kupó?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Le {color:8095}moulin n°4{color:8080} est fin prêt. Je peux l'arrêter,{line}vous savez. Vous voulez voir, kupo ?{line}{choice:2}[L'arrêter.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Se funziona bene, un mulino si può far fermare a{line}piacimento, kupò. Vediamo se il mulino {color:8095}4{color:8080} è a posto?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}しっかり整備した風車は止めたいときに止められるクポ。{line}{color:8095}第４号基{color:8080}の整備具合を確かめるクポ？{line}{choice:2}[停止させる|何もしない]
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}확실히 정비한 풍차는 멈추고 싶을 때 멈출 수 있다 쿠뽀.{line}{color:8095}제4호기{color:8080}의 정비상태를 확인할 거 쿠뽀?{line}{choice:2}[정지시킨다|아무것도 안 한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}仔细维修好的风车在想要停止的时候就能停止咕波。{line}要确认{color:8095}第４号机{color:8080}的维修状况吗咕波？{line}{choice:2}[停止|什么都不做]
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}仔細維修好的風車在想要停止的時候就能停止咕波。{line}要確認{color:8095}第４號機{color:8080}的維修狀況嗎咕波？{line}{choice:2}[停止|什麼都不做]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Nothing to it, kupo!

es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Cómo no, kupó!
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Aucun problème, kupo !

de: {name:A283E1}{line}Na? Das ist Präzisionsarbeit, was, kupo?
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¿Qué tal, kupó?{line}Se ha detenido como te he dicho, ¿kupó?
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Qu'est-ce que vous en dites, kupo ?{line}On peut dire qu'il s'est arrêté, non ?
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}どうクポ？{blank}ちゃんと止まったクポ！
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}怎么样咕波？确实停下来了咕波！
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}怎麼樣咕波？確實停下來囉咕波！

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Please, please! I've work to do, kupo. We have to{line}get all ten windmills in good order. I'm in charge{line}of {color:8095}No. 5{color:8080} here.
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Hey, hey, bin grade sehr beschäftigt, kupo. Bevor{line}die zehn Windmühlen hier nicht wieder laufen, gibt{line}es keinen Feierabend. Ich arbeite an {color:8095}Windmühle 5{color:8080}.
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Por favor, déjame trabajar, kupó! Tenemos que{line}poner a punto los diez molinos que hay aquí, kupó.{line}A mí me ha tocado el {color:8095}n.° 5{color:809B}, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Vite, vite ! J'ai du travail. Nous devons réviser{line}les dix moulins à vent. Moi, on m'a confié le{line}{color:8095}moulin n°5{color:8080}.
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Ho tantissimo lavoro da fare, kupò.{line}Ci sono dieci mulini da aggiustare.{line}Questo è quello di cui mi occupo io, il numero {color:8095}5{color:8080}.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}ちょっとちょっと、仕事の邪魔は困るクポ。{line}10基の風車を全部整備しないと仕事が終わらないクポ。{line}モグが任された{color:8095}第５号基{color:8080}は、まだ整備中クポ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}저기저기, 업무방해는 곤란 쿠뽀.{line}10기의 풍차를 전부 정비하지 않으면 일이 끝나지 않는다 쿠뽀.{line}모그가 맡은 {color:8095}제5호기{color:8080}는 아직 정비 중 쿠뽀.
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}喂喂，这样妨碍工作很令人伤脑筋咕波。{line}不把10座风车全部维修完，工作就没办法结束咕波。{line}莫古被委任的是{color:8095}第５号机{color:8080}，还在进行维修咕波。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}喂喂，這樣妨礙工作很令人傷腦筋咕波。{line}不把10座風車全部維修完，工作就沒辦法結束咕波。{line}莫古被委任的是{color:8095}第５號機{color:8080}，還在進行維修咕波。

us: {name:A283E1}{line}The {color:8095}No. 5{color:8080} mill is running smooth as can be, kupo.{line}Want to see me stop it? I'll stop it, kupo.{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]
de: {name:A283E1}{line}{color:8095}Windmühle 5{color:8080} ist top in Schuss, kupo.{line}Soll ich die Mühle mal anhalten, kupo?{line}{choice:2}[Anhalten|Drehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}El molino {color:8095}n.° 5{color:809B} funciona perfectamente, kupó.{line}¿Quieres ver cómo se detiene, kupó?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Le {color:8095}moulin n°5{color:8080} marche à merveille.{line}Si vous voulez, je l'arrête, kupo !{line}{choice:2}[L'arrêter.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Questo che dovevo aggiustare io è il mulino {color:8095}5{color:8080}.{line}Ora funziona bene, kupò. Proviamo a fermarlo?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}We're racing to see who can finish work on{line}their windmill first, kupo. I'm going to have{line}{color:8095}No. 6{color:8080} up and running before the rest!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Wir vom Mogry-Bauunternehmen wetteifern, wer{line}seine Mühle als Erster in Schuss hat, kupo. Ich{line}arbeite an {color:8095}Windmühle 6{color:8080}. Insgesamt gibt 's zehn!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Estamos compitiendo a ver quién termina primero{line}con su molino, kupó. El mío es el {color:8095}n.° 6{color:809B}, kupó.{line}¡Estará listo antes que los otros nueve, kupó!
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Nous faisons la course pour voir qui va finir la{line}révision de son moulin en premier, kupo. Il faut{line}que je répare le {color:8095}moulin n°6{color:8080} avant les autres !
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Stiamo facendo una gara a chi finisce prima i lavori.{line}Io devo aggiustare il mulino {color:8095}6{color:8080}, kupò.{line}Deve funzionare prima di tutti gli altri nove!
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}誰が先に風車の整備を終えるか競争してるクポ！{line}モグが{color:8095}第６号基{color:8080}の整備担当クポ。{line}他の９基の風車より早く仕上げるのが目標クポ！
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}누가 먼저 풍차 정비를 마치는지 경쟁 중 쿠뽀!{line}모그가 {color:8095}제6호기{color:8080}의 정비담당 쿠뽀.{line}다른 9기의 풍차보다 빨리 마치는 게 목표 쿠뽀!
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}我们在比赛看谁先把风车维修好咕波！{line}莫古负责{color:8095}第６号机{color:8080}的维修工作咕波。{line}目标是要比其他９座风车都还要更快维修好咕波！
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}我們在比賽看誰先把風車維修好咕波！{line}莫古負責{color:8095}第６號機{color:8080}的維修工作咕波。{line}目標是要比其他９座風車都還要更快維修好咕波！

us: {name:A283E1}{line}I can stop the {color:8095}No. 6{color:8080} mill if you want, kupo.{line}Stop, start. Start, stop. Kupo, kupo!{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Soll ich mal zeigen, wie butterweich {color:8095}Windmühle 6{color:8080}{line}anhält? Steckt filigranste Mechanik dahinter!{line}{choice:2}[Anhalten|Drehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¿Quieres que detenga el molino {color:8095}n.° 6{color:809B}, kupó?{line}¡Es muy fácil, kupó!{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Je peux arrêter le {color:8095}moulin n°6{color:8080} si ça vous dit.{line}Eteint, allumé. Allumé, éteint. Kupo, kupo !{line}{choice:2}[L'arrêter.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Questo è il mulino {color:8095}6{color:8080}. Volete provare a fermarlo?{line}Si può sia far partire che far fermare.{line}{choice:2}[Proviamo a fermarlo.|Lasciamo stare.]
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}この{color:8095}第６号基{color:8080}を止めてみるクポ？{line}風車は動かすだけじゃなく、止めるのも自由自在クポ！{line}{choice:2}[停止させる|何もしない]
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}이 {color:8095}제6호기{color:8080}를 멈춰볼 거 쿠뽀?{line}풍차는 움직이는 것뿐 아니라 멈추는 것도 자유자재 쿠뽀!{line}{choice:2}[정지시킨다|아무것도 안 한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}要停止这座{color:8095}第６号机{color:8080}看看吗咕波？{line}不只能让风车动，也可随意让它停下来咕波！{line}{choice:2}[停止|什么都不做]
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}要停止這座{color:8095}第６號機{color:8080}看看嗎咕波？{line}不只能讓風車動，也可隨意讓它停下來咕波！{line}{choice:2}[停止|什麼都不做]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Work, work. Kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Zu Befehl, kupo!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡A la orden, kupó!
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Hop hop hop, kupo !
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}アイアイクポ～！
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}没问题咕波～！
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}沒問題咕波～！

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Windmill's stopped, kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Haltekommando ausgeführt, kupo!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Se ha detenido, kupó!
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Moulin arrêté, kupo !
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}ストップしたクポ～！
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}停下来了咕波～！
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}停下來了咕波～！

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Not interested, kupo?
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Welch schmerzendes Desinteresse, kupo!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¿No te gustan los molinos, kupó?...
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Ça ne vous intéresse pas, kupo ?
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}……どうでもいいクポ？
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}……觉得无所谓吗咕波？
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}……覺得無所謂嗎咕波？

us: {name:A283E1}{line}I can start the {color:8095}No. 6{color:8080} mill if you want, kupo.{line}A windmill isn't a windmill unless it's milling!{line}{choice:2}[Start the windmill.|Do nothing.]
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Soll ich mal zeigen, wie butterweich {color:8095}Windmühle 6{color:8080}{line}andreht? Steckt filigranste Mechanik dahinter!{line}{choice:2}[In Gang setzen|Still stehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¿Pongo en marcha el molino {color:8095}n.° 6{color:809B}, kupó?{line}¡Es muy fácil, kupó!{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Je peux mettre le {color:8095}moulin n°6{color:8080} en route si ça vous{line}dit. Eteint, allumé. Allumé, éteint. Kupo, kupo !{line}{choice:2}[Le mettre en route.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Volete provare a far funzionare il mulino {color:8095}6{color:8080}?{line}Se non gira, che mulino è?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}この{color:8095}第６号基{color:8080}を動かしたいクポ？{line}風車はグルングルン回ってこそ風車クポ！{line}{choice:2}[動かす|何もしない]
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}이 {color:8095}제6호기{color:8080}를 움직일 거 쿠뽀?{line}풍차는 빙글빙글 돌려야 풍차 쿠뽀!{line}{choice:2}[움직인다|아무것도 안 한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}要让这座{color:8095}第６号机{color:8080}转动吗咕波？{line}风车就是要转动才是风车啊咕波！{line}{choice:2}[转动|什么都不做]
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}要讓這座{color:8095}第６號機{color:8080}轉動嗎咕波？{line}風車就是要轉動才是風車啊咕波！{line}{choice:2}[轉動|什麼都不做]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}The salt in the air has made a mess of these{line}mills. We've got to service all ten on the Steppe.{line}I'm working on {color:8095}No. 7{color:8080}, kupo.
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Salzige Winde haben die zehn Windmühlen hier ros-{line}ten lassen, kupo. Aber kein Problem für das Mogry-{line}Bauunternehmen. Ich repariere {color:8095}Windmühle 7{color:8080}, kupo.
es: {name:A283E1}{line}El viento del mar perjudica a los molinos,{line}kupó. En Cerobi hay diez de ellos, y a mí me{line}toca mantener el {color:8095}n.° 7{color:809B}, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Le sel qu'il y a dans l'air a abîmé les rouages des{line}moulins de Cérobi. Nous les révisons tous les dix.{line}Moi, je m'occupe du {color:8095}moulin n°7{color:8080}, kupo.
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Questo mulino è il numero {color:8095}7{color:8080}, kupò.{line}Era tutto rovinato e così lo sto riparando.{line}Nell'Altopiano di Cerobi ce ne sono dieci!
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}潮風で調子が悪くなった風車の整備中クポ。{line}セロビ台地には全部で10基の風車があるクポ。{line}モグが面倒を見ているのは{color:8095}第７号基{color:8080}クポ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}바닷바람에 상태가 나빠진 풍차를 정비 중 쿠뽀.{line}세로비 대지에는 총 10기의 풍차가 있다 쿠뽀.{line}모그가 돌보고 있는 건 {color:8095}제7호기{color:8080} 쿠뽀.
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}我正在维修因海风而有点坏掉的风车咕波。{line}榭洛比台地共有10座风车咕波。{line}莫古负责的是{color:8095}第７号机{color:8080}咕波。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}我正在維修因海風而有點壞掉的風車咕波。{line}榭洛比台地共有10座風車咕波。{line}莫古負責的是{color:8095}第７號機{color:8080}咕波。

us: {name:A283E1}{line}I've replaced the parts, so the brakes on{line}{color:8095}No. 7{color:8080} are better than ever. Need it stopped?{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Dank brandneuer Komponenten ist {color:8095}Windmühle 7{color:8080}{line}kupo bedienungsfreundlich. 'ne Demonstration?{line}{choice:2}[Anhalten|Drehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}He cambiado algunas piezas; el freno del molino{line}{color:8095}n.° 7{color:809B} está como nuevo. ¿Quieres probarlo, kupó?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}J'ai changé les pièces rouillées du {color:8095}moulin n°7{color:8080}.{line}Il est comme neuf. Je l'arrête, kupo ?{line}{choice:2}[L'arrêter.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}C'erano dei pezzi da cambiare, ma ora dovrebbe{line}essere tutto a posto. Proviamo a fermarlo, kupò?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}部品を交換したから、風車の制動は簡単クポ。{line}{color:8095}第７号基{color:8080}を止めてみるクポ？{line}{choice:2}[停止させる|何もしない]
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}부품을 교환했으니, 풍차의 제동은 간단 쿠뽀.{line}{color:8095}제7호기{color:8080}를 멈출 거 쿠뽀?{line}{choice:2}[정지시킨다|아무것도 안 한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}只要更换零件，就能轻易操纵风车咕波。{line}要把{color:8095}第７号机{color:8080}停下来看看吗咕波？{line}{choice:2}[停止|什么都不做]
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}只要更換零件，就能輕易操縱風車咕波。{line}要把{color:8095}第７號機{color:8080}停下來看看嗎咕波？{line}{choice:2}[停止|什麼都不做]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Behold the workings of a properly tuned windmill,{line}kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}So etwas vollbringt nur Mogry-Technik, kupo!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Mira el resultado de mi trabajo, kupó!
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Regardez un peu comme un moulin bien révisé{line}répond au doigt et à l'œil, kupo !

de: {name:A283E1}{line}Ohne Probleme gestoppt, kupo!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Se ha detenido sin problemas, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Il s'est arrêté pile-poil, kupo !
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}問題なく止まったクポ。
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}完美地停下来了咕波。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}完美地停下來了咕波。

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Aww...I wanted to show you how well I'd tuned{line}it up, kupo.
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Gern hätte ich mein Können bewiesen, kupo!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Lástima, kupó... Quería mostrarte{line}lo bien que funciona, kupó...
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Ooooh... Je voulais vous montrer comme je l'avais{line}bien réglé, kupo...

ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}只要更換零件，就能輕易啟動風車咕波。{line}要讓{color:8095}第７號機{color:8080}轉動看看嗎咕波？{line}{choice:2}[轉動|什麼都不做]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}The Craftsmoogles' League's been commissioned to{line}overhaul all ten of the Cerobi mills. I'll have{line}{color:8095}No. 8{color:8080} up and running again in no time, kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Windmühlenwartung? Kein Problem fürs Mogry-{line}Bauunternehmen, kupo. {color:8095}Windmühle 8{color:8080} ist so gut{line}wie fertig, kupo!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Nos han encomendado a los Mogulaboriosos el{line}mantenimiento de los diez molinos de Cerobi, kupó.{line}Este, el {color:8095}n.° 8{color:809B}, estará listo en un pispás, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}La Compagnie des Mogs doit réviser les dix moulins{line}de Cérobi. Je vais remettre le {color:8095}moulin n°8{color:8080} en état de{line}marche, kupo, vous pouvez compter sur moi !
it: {name:A283E1}{line}L'Edilmogu si occupa anche di mulini, kupò.{line}Questo, il numero {color:8095}8{color:8080}, è quasi a posto.{line}Voglio essere il primo a finire i lavori!
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}風車の整備もモーグリ工務店の業務クポ。{line}{color:8095}第８号基{color:8080}ちゃんは、もうじき整備完了クポ。{line}全10基の風車のうち、一番に仕事を済ませたいクポ！

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Have to finish my work. Mustn't upset the master.{line}{color:8095}No. 9{color:8080} of the lot of ten is my charge, kupo.
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Wenn die Wartungsarbeiten nicht schnell erledigt{line}sind, gibt 's Motze von Meister Mogrowsky, kupo.{line}Ich kümmer mich um {color:8095}Windmühle 9{color:8080}.
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Si no termino esto pronto, el capataz se{line}enfadará, kupó... Hay diez molinos en Cerobi,{line}y a mí me ha tocado reparar el {color:8095}n.° 9{color:809B}, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Il faut que je finisse mon travail ! Je ne voudrais{line}surtout pas contrarier le maître. Je dois réparer{line}le {color:8095}moulin n°9{color:8080} parmi les dix des plateaux, kupo.
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Se non mi sbrigo, chi lo sente il capomastro?{line}Sull'Altopiano di Cerobi ci sono dieci mulini, kupò.{line}Io aggiusto il numero {color:8095}9{color:8080}.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}早く整備を終わらせないと、親方に怒られるクポ……。{line}風車は、このセロビ台地に全部で10基クポ。{line}モグは{color:8095}第９号基{color:8080}の担当クポ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}빨리 정비를 마치지 않으면 사장님 화낸다 쿠뽀……{line}풍차는 이 세로비 대지에 총 10기 쿠뽀.{line}모그는 {color:8095}제9호기{color:8080}의 담당 쿠뽀.
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}要是不快点完成维修，可是会被工头骂的咕波……{line}这个榭洛比台地共有10座风车咕波。{line}莫古负责{color:8095}第９号机{color:8080}咕波。
ch: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}要是不快點完成維修，可是會被工頭罵的咕波……{line}這個榭洛比台地共有10座風車咕波。{line}莫古負責{color:8095}第９號機{color:8080}咕波。

us: {name:A283E1}{line}I'm more or less finished fixing up the windmill,{line}kupo. Just doing a few last minute checks.{page}This is the {color:8095}No. 9{color:8080} windmill, don't you know. It's{line}running right now...want me to stop it, kupo?{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Die Arbeiten an dieser Mühle sind so gut wie{line}fertig, kupo. Bin gerade dabei, alle Mechanismen{line}nochmal gründlich zu überprüfen.{page}Dies ist {color:8095}Windmühle 9{color:8080}, kupo. Im Moment läuft{line}sie, aber ich kann sie auch anhalten.{line}{choice:2}[Anhalten|Drehen lassen]
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Pronto terminaré de reparar el molino, kupó.{line}Solo falta comprobar que esté todo en orden, kupó.{page}Este es el molino {color:8095}n.° 9{color:809B}, kupó. Está en marcha,{line}pero puedo detenerlo si quieres. ¿Kupopó?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}J'ai à peu près fini la révision du moulin, kupo.{line}Il ne me reste plus que quelques vérifications{line}de dernière minute à faire.{page}Ceci est le {color:8095}moulin n°9{color:8080}, au cas où vous l'auriez{line}oublié. Je l'arrête, kupo ?{line}{choice:2}[L'arrêter.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Ho quasi finito. Sto facendo la revisione finale.{page}Questo è il mulino {color:8095}9{color:8080}, kupò.{line}Proviamo a farlo fermare?{line}{choice:2}[Sì.|No.]
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}この風車のメンテナンスは、もう少しで完了クポ。{line}今は、いろいろチェックしているところなんだクポ～。{page}この風車は{color:8095}第９号基{color:8080}クポよ。{line}今は動いているクポけど、停止させてみるクポか？{line}{choice:2}[停止させる|何もしない]
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}이 풍차의 정비는 곧 완료 쿠뽀.{line}지금은 여러모로 체크 중 쿠뽀~{page}이 풍차는 {color:8095}제9호기{color:8080} 쿠뽀다.{line}지금은 움직이는데, 정지시켜 볼 거 쿠뽀?{line}{choice:2}[정지시킨다|아무것도 안 한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}这座风车的保养就快完成了咕波。{line}现在正进行各种确认咕波～{page}这座风车是{color:8095}第９号机{color:8080}咕波。{line}虽然现在在转动，但要让它停下来看看吗咕波？{line}{choice:2}[停止|什么都不做]

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Kupo-po!? You shouldn't sneak up on people{line}like that! And what exactly are you doing up{line}there in the first place, kupo?

fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Kupopo ?! Vous m'avez fait peur, kupo !{line}Mais qu'est-ce que vous faites là-haut, d'abord ?
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Kupò-pò-pò?! Che colpo!{line}E tu da dove salti fuori?{line}E, soprattutto, chi sei?
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}クポポポッ!?{blank}びっくりしたクポッ！{line}じいさん、どこから出てくるクポ！{line}それよりそもそも何者クポッ!?
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}쿠뽀뽀뽀!? 깜짝 놀랐다 쿠뽀!{line}할아버지, 어디서 나온 거 쿠뽀!{line}그보다 애초에 누구 쿠뽀!?
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}咕波波波！？吓我一跳咕波！{line}老爷爷，你是从哪里冒出来的咕波！？{line}而且你是谁啊咕波！？

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Small wonder my work on the windmill met with{line}so little success. You were more than dozing up{line}there, kupo. I'd say you were hibernating!{page}These people slew your vyraal while you were{line}sound asleep, kupo! I saw the whole thing!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Und ich hab hier geschraubt und geschraubt und{line}nichts tat sich. Das war also deine Schuld, Opa?{line}Weil du auf der Drehfelge geschlafen hast, kupo!?{page}Von wegen eingenickt! Winterschlaf nenn ich das!{line}Als du so kupo am Ratzen warst, haben {fixed-advance:8194}die da{fixed-advance:8180}{line}übrigens diesen Viraal erledigt!{page}Kann ich jetzt wohl endlich meine Arbeit zu{line}Ende führen? Kupo!?
es: {name:A283E1}{line}¡Ahora entiendo por qué el molino no quería{line}moverse, kupó! Claro, como te habías quedado{line}dormido encima de la rueda, kupó...{page}Mientras dormías, aquel chico ha despachado{line}a ese Vairal que tanto querías ver, kupó...{line}Yo no me he perdido nada de la acción, kupó.
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Je comprends mieux pourquoi je n'arrivais à rien{line}avec ce moulin. Vous n'avez pas fait que vous{line}assoupir là-haut, kupo... vous avez hiberné !{page}Ces gens-là ont terrassé votre vyraal pendant{line}que vous dormiez et vous n'avez rien entendu,{line}kupo ! Je peux vous le dire, j'ai tout vu !
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Ecco perché non si muoveva, sei tu che{line}bloccavi tutto dormendo sulla pala, kupò!{line}Ma non avevi proprio altro posto?{page}Mentre dormivi, il tuo Viral è stato{line}abbattuto, sai? Io da qui ho visto tutto.
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}いくら整備しても風車が動かなかったのは、{line}じいさんがリムの上で寝てたからクポ？{line}何がウトウトクポ！{blank}寝すぎクポ！{page}じいさんが寝てる間に、お探しのヴィラールって竜は{line}そこにいる人が退治しちゃったクポ！{line}モグはここから一部始終を見守っていたクポ！
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}아무리 정비해도 풍차가 안 움직인 건{line}할아버지가 림 위에서 잤기 때문 쿠뽀?{line}졸음 아님 쿠뽀! 너무 잤다 쿠뽀!{page}할아버지 자는 사이에, 비랄이라는 용은{line}저기 있는 사람이 퇴치해 버렸다 쿠뽀!{line}모그는 여기서 자초지종을 다 바라봤다 쿠뽀!
cn: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}之所以不管我怎么维修，风车都不会动，{line}是因为老爷爷在转轮上面睡觉吗咕波？{line}什么打瞌睡啊咕波！你根本就是睡过头了咕波！{page}你要找的威拉尔，{line}在你睡着的期间，已经被那个人给击退了咕波！{line}莫古可是在这里亲眼见证了一切咕波！

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Windmill {color:8095}No. 10{color:8080} of ten, up and running at last,{line}thanks in no small part to the absence of that{line}silly man, kupo.{page}Small wonder I couldn't repair the windmill,{line}with him sitting on the wheel the whole time.{line}Of all the places to sit, kupo!
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Dies ist {color:8095}Windmühle 10{color:8080}, kupo. Die letzte der zehn{line}Mühlen in der Cerobi-Steppe, kupo. Und ich{line}hatte schon an meinen Schraubkünsten gezweifelt!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Este es el molino {color:8095}n.° 10{color:809B} de los diez de Cerobi, kupó.{line}Ahora que se ha ido aquel viejito, podré ponerme{line}manos a la obra, kupó.{page}Con el viejito acostado sobre la rueda,{line}no había forma de que el molino se moviera, kupó.{line}¿A quién se le ocurre, kupopó?...
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Ça y est, le {color:8095}moulin n°10{color:8080} marche enfin !{line}Sûrement en grande partie parce que{line}l'autre crétin n'est plus là, kupo...{page}Il dormait sur la roue principale ! Pas étonnant{line}que le moulin ait été bloqué ! Franchement, il n'y{line}a pas de meilleur endroit pour dormir, kupo ?!
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Sull'Altopiano di Cerobi ci sono dieci mulini.{line}E questo è proprio il numero {color:8095}10{color:8080}, kupò.{page}Ora che quel signore non c'è più, posso lavorare.{line}Era seduto su una pala, ci credo che il mulino{line}non si muoveva!
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}この風車は、セロビ台地に10基ある風車のうちの{line}{color:8095}第10号基{color:8080}クポ。{line}あのじいさんがいなくなって、やっと整備できるクポ。{page}じいさんがリムに座っていたから、何をしても{line}風車が動かなかったクポ！{blank}迷惑なじいさんクポ！

us: {name:A283E1}{line}The Craftsmoogles' League was commissioned with{line}servicing the windmills on Cerobi Steppe, and{line}I'm in charge of this one, {color:8095}No. 10{color:8080}.{page}For some reason this is the only one that isn't{line}working. The other nine are happy as can be.{line}Did I break something, kupo?
de: {name:A283E1}{line}Die zehn Windmühlen in der Cerobi-Steppe werden{line}vom Mogry-Bauunternehmen gewartet, kupo. Ich{line}repariere {color:8095}Windmühle 10{color:8080}.{page}Doch ich bin mit meinem Mogry-Latein am Ende.{line}Diese Mühle will sich einfach nicht drehen, kupo!{line}Meister Mogrowsky zieht mir den Bommel lang!
es: {name:A283E1}{line}Los Mogulaboriosos estamos poniendo a punto{line}los diez molinos de Cerobi, uno cada uno, kupó.{line}A mí me ha tocado el {color:8095}n.° 10{color:809B}, kupó.{page}No sé por qué, pero no logro que se mueva, kupó.{line}¡Los otros nueve funcionan sin problemas, kupó!{line}¿Habré metido la pata, kupopó?...
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}La Compagnie des Mogs a été chargée de la révision{line}des moulins des plateaux de Cérobi. Je m'occupe{line}de celui-ci, le {color:8095}moulin n°10{color:8080}, kupo.{page}Bizarrement, c'est le seul qui ne marche pas.{line}Le neuf autres fonctionnent parfaitement.{line}Aurais-je cassé quelque chose, kupo ?
it: {name:A283E1}{line}Sull'Altopiano di Cerobi ci sono dieci mulini{line}e l'Edilmogu deve aggiustarli tutti, kupò.{line}Io mi occupo di questo, il numero {color:8095}10{color:8080}.{page}Non so come mai... è l'unico che non funziona.{line}Gli altri nove non hanno problemi. Chissà perché?{line}Non avrò mica sbagliato qualcosa?
in: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}このセロビ台地には10基の風車があって、{line}モーグリ工務店の仲間と分担して整備中クポ。{line}モグの担当は、この{color:8095}第10号基{color:8080}クポ。{page}……なぜか、この風車だけが動いてくれないクポ。{line}他の風車９基は順調に作動するのにどうしてクポ？{line}モグ、何か悪いことしたクポ～？
kr: {spacing:8181}{name:A283E1}{line}이 세로비 대지에는 10기의 풍차가 있어서,{line}모그리 공무점의 동료들과 분담해서 정비 중 쿠뽀.{line}모그의 담당은 이 {color:8095}제10호기{color:8080} 쿠뽀.{page}……왠지 이 풍차만 움직이지 않는다 쿠뽀.{line}다른 풍차 9기는 순조로이 작동하는데 어째서 쿠뽀?{line}모그, 뭔가 나쁜 짓 했었나 쿠뽀~?

us: {name:A283E1}{line}Just have a little fine tuning left to do and{line}{color:8095}No. 10{color:8080} will be good as new. Want me to stop it?{line}{choice:2}[Stop the windmill.|Do nothing.]

es: {name:A283E1}{line}El molino {color:8095}n.° 10{color:809B} ya está listo; ahora lo estoy{line}probando, kupó. ¿Quieres ver cómo lo detengo?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, por favor.|No, gracias.]
fr: {name:A283E1}{line}Je suis en train de finir de régler le {color:8095}moulin n°10{color:8080}.{line}Vous voulez que je l'arrête, kupo ?{line}{choice:2}[L'arrêter.|Ne rien faire.]
